snippet.title: Police Chief Simulator: Prologue - Early Days Release Date Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
🎮 Add to STEAM WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224800/Police_Chief_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/
🎮 Check out FULL VERSION: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2938460/Police_Chief_Simulator/

Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

⭐ Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ApRnKkbEd6
